idea: Speckled bird eggs fly onto a bare page one by one until, together, they spell the numeral 5, and then the page gives the film its name.
leave: Many small, different things can add up to one clear shape.
subject: the pile of eggs, from a scatter to a 5

device.what: eggs that land on quarter beats, one at a time at first and then in twos and threes
device.why: the shape only reads once enough eggs are down, so the speed-up carries the viewer toward it

change.from: two eggs on bare beige paper, more flying in from the edges
change.to: about fifteen eggs spread over the page, only hinting at a shape
eggs landing two and three at a time until they fill a 5, and the view eases in on it

change.from: the eggs gone, bare beige paper
change.to: flipbook set in the middle of the page
